name: obsidian-kit
description: Shared, drift-free modules extracted from Johannes Kaindl's Obsidian plugins
author: Johannes Kaindl

scripts.check:index-strict: tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --target ES2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler src/pure/frontmatter.ts src/pure/endpoint.ts src/pure/endpoint_config.ts src/pure/i18n.ts src/pure/settings.ts src/pure/model-choice.ts src/pure/model-list-cache.ts
scripts.test: node scripts/check-no-abs-paths.mjs && node scripts/check-no-nul-bytes.mjs && npm run check:index-strict && npm run lint && vitest run
